application_filter.algorithm: GetCanAddGroups rejects255, permits an application absent from the standard table, permits standard field+0x3a=true, and additionally permits25 and172. The combo separately permits255.
application_filter.selected_application_precondition: A changed non255 address must exist in the frozen source-network Application collection. No missing metadata is silently created. Unchanged legacy values are preserved.

route.model_change: ChangeBridgeAddress 0xd42cf0 clears its model addresses, initializes seven output entries to255, and invokes BuildForwardingRoute with the gateway network, chosen destination, and gateway unit address.
route.direction: BuildForwardingRoute 0xd3f44c looks up the adjacent project network by gateway UNIT address. CanAddNetwork 0xd3f50c follows an actual bridge unit from its containing network to the project network whose address equals that unit address; it skips the previous network and already visited networks. It does not synthesize reverse edges or require reciprocal bridge halves.
route.original_bridge_predicate: IsBridge 0xf415f4 lowercases the type and recognizes bridge1n, bridge2n, bridge1f, bridge2f, gatewls, gatewlsn, gatewlsf, wgate5n, wgate5f, wgate5xn, wgate5xf.
route.destination_list: LoadRemoteNetworks 0xd42860 and ExploreRemoteNetwork 0xd42748 exclude the source and initially adjacent network. Stored route entries contain networks beyond the initial adjacent network.
route.save: BeforeSave 0x1258f30 sets ForwardingMode from first bridge !=255 and appends six bridge slots, testing EACH slot independently at 0x1259054..0x1259114. The first255 records depth=index+1. Later non255 entries are retained. With forwarding enabled, GetDepthAndCountByte 0x1258f08 prepends depth+8*depth.
route.load: AfterLoad 0x1258ca0 loads stored indices1..6 when forwarding is enabled, replacing each individually missing project network with255 at 0x1258daa..0x1258dd8. Destination selection at 0x1258dff..0x1258e55 uses the contiguous prefix only.
route.bounded_route_encoding: Only contiguous one-to-five extra-network routes are written: header9*(extra_count+1), route entries, then255 padding to seven bytes. Six non255 slots leave original local depth0 (header0), so six-extra-network writes remain refused.
route.explicit_disable: The editor normalizes an explicit disable to ForwardingMode0 plus seven255 bytes. Original disabled-save loop appends six255 entries without a header; its reusable string-buffer lifecycle is not established. The fixed seven-byte normalization is a bounded database operation, not an exact original parent-save claim.
route.fail_closed: Freeze source identity, networks, interfaces, actual unit identities and Application membership. Reject missing, ambiguous, cyclic, disconnected or unsupported bridge profiles before PP mutation. Do not silently rewrite a malformed stored tail for a non-route edit.

application_change_dependencies.scene_hooks: Advanced ApplicationChanged 0xd44acc and Application2Changed 0xd44aa4 invoke RefreshSceneGroupsFromApplication 0xd45214. App255 clears matching scene commands and resets the secondary flag. A non255 replacement rebinds each command group by address through the new application, potentially creating project metadata.
application_change_dependencies.remote_hooks: SetupRemotes 0x110e2e8 creates all eight directors regardless of Network Gateway mode. SetupFlashHooks 0x110a840 registers Application1/2 callbacks. HandleApplication1Change 0x110d918 sets primary group nil for255, otherwise a missing or mismatched group becomes group255 of the new application. HandleApplication2Change 0x110db08 does the analogous reset, but255 toggles secondary keys to primary through HandleAppSwitcherPress 0x110dce4 / SetPrimaryApplication 0xd459b0 and clears their group selection.
application_change_dependencies.boundary: Do not preserve configured mappings across application edits as if that reproduced the original callbacks. Route, adjacent, synchronisation and status edits preserve the remote tables; application edits require an empty scene/mapping state in this slice.

whole_dialog_save_boundary.scope: Connection plans write only changed Connection parameters. They are not execution of the complete original dialog or wireless parent save.
whole_dialog_save_boundary.use_security: Wireless BeforeSaveProgrammingInformation 0x1258434 computes UseSecurity but clears attribute flag+0x58 at0x1258521; generic Set guard0xcbb696..0xcbb69a skips it. SaveProgrammingInformation 0xcbdc30 performs main SAVE at0xcbde7e, then ProjectSave at0xcbdecb..0xcbdeee, then LoadStatus at0xcbdef4..0xcbdf12, then AfterSave dispatch0xcbdf1d. Wireless AfterSave0x1257e40 calls SaveEncryptionParam0x1257f10: a SEPARATE terminal PP START/LOAD/SET UseSecurity/SAVE with6000ms timeout. It is not part of the first SAVE.
whole_dialog_save_boundary.terminal_failure: SaveEncryptionParam catches ECGateCommand at0x125802f, records Unit not responding, and does not retry. Matching existing session uses that lock; otherwise it acquires and cleans up its own session/lock.

acceptance_boundary.native_preconditions: Malformed plans and mismatched targets fail in preconnect preflight without PP reads. Valid targets require fresh consumed DB XML facts, exact source-network lock, exclusive project ownership and all project networks closed/idle. PP SAVE updates the database unit; PROJECT SAVE is a separate caller action and is explicitly exercised by native acceptance.
